neighbours.label: The verb 'need' (need, needs, needed) and 'arises' for a need or vacancy that comes up
fire: They kept their contraband hidden, but when the need actually hits, anyone living there can find it.
You really need to make an extra effort to ensure that the whole team understands the plan.
Pay for the service in advance, since you never know when you will need to stop it for a while.
Our guys understand the areas we need to work on and they are attacking them every day.
If a vacancy arises, it is filled by the county committee within thirty days of the notice.
Whenever a need arises, the volunteers are called, and they meet at the hall within the hour.
The children needed new coats before winter, and the school fund paid for all of them.
She needs a quiet room to work in, and the house has none to spare right now.
